text:
liz_eng: Heads-up — after pushing the 550.86 DKMS bundle to us-east-gpu-canary, ~8 nodes failed to finish boot (kernel panic avoided but stuck during initramfs). Logs show "nvidia: module not found" and a bunch of broken symlink errors under /lib/modules/*/updates.
cheng_infra: can you paste the exact dkms output? also which kernel versions on those hosts?
liz_eng: ./deploy log: `DKMS: add completed.` then `depmod: WARNING: could not open modules.dep for kernel 5.15.0-1029-aws` and `modprobe: FATAL: Module nvidia not found in directory /lib/modules/5.15.0-1029-aws`
sre-bot: [alert] gpu-provisioning/us-east: 8 nodes failed (degraded capacity - 12% of pool). Auto-eviction paused for canary.
max_ops: this smells like header mismatch or our post-install script failing to update initramfs. last time that happened it was due to our custom kernel-rt shim not exporting uname -r correctly. oll: try `dkms status` and `ls -l /lib/modules/*/updates/dkms/`
anna_platform: quick note — these hosts were running a custom boot arg `roth=1` for nvlink testing. only canary subset. can we confirm other regions?
liz_eng: confirmed not in eu-west or apac (only us-east-canary AZs). `dkms status` shows the driver installed but the directory under /lib/modules/5.15.0-1029-aws/updates/ is empty, symlinks pointing to /var/lib/dkms/nvidia/550.86/build but that path doesn't exist — looks like our package used a different build id and cleanup removed it during postinstall.
max_ops: immediate mitigation: 1) mark offending nodes unschedulable and drain, 2) revert the DKMS package on canary (yum rollback or apt-get), 3) if revert not quick, copy working module files from healthy nodes: `scp node-good:/lib/modules/5.15.0-1029-aws/kernel/drivers/video/nvidia.ko /lib/modules/... && depmod -a && systemctl reboot`
cheng_infra: +1 to revert. Also file a short blamelist for packaging script — likely the new postinst uses `dkms remove --all` too aggressively.
oncall_julie: I'm oncall for the next 40m. if you need immediate approvals for rollback, ping me.
liz_eng: rolling back 550.86 -> 545.45 on 4 nodes now (orchestrator job 3421). will monitor.
sre-bot: [update] rollback jobs started; capacity impact: predicted +6% latency for queued provisioning in next 5m.
max_ops: once nodes are back, run `sudo dkms status && sudo depmod -a && sudo update-initramfs -u -k $(uname -r)` to ensure symlinks and initramfs include module. Also recommend we add a postinstall smoke test in packaging: boot a VM, verify `modinfo nvidia` and `modprobe nvidia` succeed.
anna_platform: filing infra ticket with packagers and kernel-build group, assigning to @cheng_infra and @liz_eng. ticket: INFRA-6732. include logs: /var/lib/dkms/nvidia/*, `dpkg -l | grep nvidia` and `uname -r`.
liz_eng: update — 3 nodes finished reboot and are back in rotation. one node still hung on initramfs; manual rescue showed missing /var/lib/dkms/nvidia/550.86/build. copying from healthy node fixed it. will push hotfix script to orchestrator.
max_ops: long-term: stop relying on ephemeral build paths. package should install into /usr/lib/modules-nvidia/<version>/build and populate /lib/modules/*/updates with copies (not symlinks). open PR for packager.
cheng_infra: agreed. also add a canary gating that verifies `modprobe nvidia` + small CUDA smoke (nv-smi) before promoting.
oncall_julie: noted. pushing oncall postmortem template now. :thumbsup:
liz_eng: thanks all — keeping the thread updated if anything regresses.
